messages:
Maya (AE): Hey team - OrchidBank sent the SIG and asked for question-by-question artifacts. They want a staged bundle by EOD Thursday so their risk team can review before the Friday POC. Link to questionnaire: https://sig.example.com/orchidbank-2026.pdf
Owen (SE): I can own Q1-12 (networking, auth, infra). Will need network diagrams + VPC peering config. Maya can you confirm whether we share full diagrams or redacted versions?
Maya (AE): @Owen, please provide redacted diagrams first. The customer is ok with more details after NDA addendum. Also we should use the secure staging area, not public Drive.
Priya (SecOps): Agree on secure staging. Please upload to our protected box folder or S3 path with bucket-level encryption. No raw keys in artifacts. I'll generate an evidence checklist and mark which Qs require policies vs screenshots.
Owen (SE): Proposed artifact naming: ORCHID_SIG_Q{number}_{artifact-type}_{owner}.pdf e.g. ORCHID_SIG_Q3_netdiag_Owen.pdf. Will upload initial set to s3://redwood-secure/orchidbank/sig-staging/
Maya (AE): s3 link is fine. I'll share access with Jordan's reviewer. Jordan, FYI we'll redact IPs initially.
Jordan (Customer): Thanks Maya. Redacted diagrams are fine for initial review. Can you also include a statement about encryption at rest? Their compliance team flagged KMS rotation as high priority.
Priya (SecOps): Noted. I will attach our KMS rotation policy snippet (rotate every 90 days), CMK usage diagram, and a short audit log excerpt (redacted).
Owen (SE): Quick ask — which questions need environment-specific screenshots (console/console commands) vs generic policy docs? If we need console screenshots I can capture them from the staging account.
Maya (AE): Q5, Q7, Q18 require screenshots. The rest can be answered with docs and architecture notes. I'll paste the mapping after this message.
Maya (AE): Q5 (network boundaries) -> diagram + VPC peering config; Q7 (auth) -> 2FA flow + RBAC screenshots; Q18 (logging) -> sample log entry + retention policy.
Priya (SecOps): Tagging priorities: high = Q7 (MFA/SSO), Q12 (encryption), Q18 (audit logging). I'll draft short answers for those and Owen can append screenshots.
Owen (SE): Uploaded initial files:
```
ls -la /tmp/orchid_upload
-rw-r--r-- 1 owen staff  42K Mar 10 09:12 ORCHID_SIG_Q1_netdiag_Owen.pdf
-rw-r--r-- 1 owen staff  8K  Mar 10 09:15 ORCHID_SIG_Q7_authflow_Owen.png
```
drive-bot: New file uploaded to s3://redwood-secure/orchidbank/sig-staging/ORCHID_SIG_Q1_netdiag_Owen.pdf
drive-bot: New file uploaded to s3://redwood-secure/orchidbank/sig-staging/ORCHID_SIG_Q7_authflow_Owen.png
Maya (AE): Thanks Owen. Priya, I'm assigning Q7 and Q12 to you for policy text; Owen will add screenshots for Q7. Q1-4 stay with Owen.
Priya (SecOps): On it. I'll attach the KMS rotation doc and the high-level key access matrix here once redacted. Also please confirm we can share the SOC2 cover letter; customer asked for evidence of controls in scope.
Maya (AE): We can share the redacted SOC2 summary report (cover letter + scope) — not the full report. I'll upload the redacted PDF to the same bucket and tag it ORCHID_SIG_SOC2_summary.pdf
Owen (SE): One blocker — our staging account's CloudTrail exports include full ARNs with internal account IDs. Need guidance on redaction format. Priya, should I mask account numbers or replace with <ACCOUNT_ID>?
Priya (SecOps): Replace internal account IDs with <ACCOUNT_ID> and mask any customer-specific ARNs. Keep event names and timestamps intact for audit context. I'll add a short README file describing redaction rules.
Jordan (Customer): Appreciate the redaction approach. Also can you confirm whether RBAC screenshots will show role names? Their team prefers role names abstracted.
Owen (SE): I'll abstract role names to high-level groups (admin, dev, observer) in the screenshots.
Maya (AE): Timeline check — can engineering/secops upload prioritized artifacts by EOD Thursday? I'll consolidate and send the ZIP to the customer on Friday morning.
Priya (SecOps): Yes, will prioritize Q7 and Q12 first. Expect policy drafts by 1700 PT Thursday.
Owen (SE): I'll finish Q1-4 and Q5 screenshots by 1600 PT Thursday.
Maya (AE): Perfect. I'll follow up with an email to Jordan with the S3 presigned links after upload. Thanks team :thumbsup:
